clinicInfo.workingHours: Monday - Saturday: 09:30 AM - 08:00 PM | Sunday: 09:30 AM - 01:00 PM (Prior Appointment)

doctor.name: Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini
doctor.title: Chief Physiotherapist & Rehabilitation Specialist
doctor.qualification: MPT (Neurology), BPT, MIAP, Certified Bobath, Taping & PNF Practitioner
doctor.specialization: Comprehensive Physiotherapy Care (Neurological, Orthopedic, Sports, Post-Op, Women’s Health, Cardiology & Pulmonology)
doctor.bio:
Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini is a physiotherapist with a master's degree in neurological physiotherapy (MPT Neuro) and four years of clinical practice. She is a member of the Indian Association of Physiotherapists.

Her work covers neurological recovery, back, neck and joint pain, rehabilitation after surgery, sports injuries and women's health. Each plan starts from assessment: a full history, a look at how you move on camera, a reading of your scans, and an exercise programme built around what she finds.

services.title: Neuro Consultation
services.description: Specialist consultation for neurological conditions (Stroke, Paralysis, Parkinson’s, Cerebral Palsy, Neuropathy, Bell’s Palsy, Ataxia). Patient writes their specific symptoms, health issues, and uploads scans.
highlights: Specialist Assessment by Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini

services.title: Ortho Consultation
services.description: Specialist consultation for orthopedic, joint, spine, and musculoskeletal conditions (Back Pain, Sciatica, Disc Bulge, Neck Stiffness, Frozen Shoulder, Knee Pain). Patient writes their pain issues and uploads reports.

services.title: Gynic Consultation
services.description: Specialist women’s health physiotherapy consultation for antenatal/postnatal care, pelvic floor muscle weakness, diastasis recti, and pregnancy-related pain. Patient writes their concerns in confidence and uploads records.

services.title: Sports Consultation
services.description: Specialist sports injury evaluation, athletic rehab, certified kinesiology taping assessment, ligament injury recovery (ACL/MCL/Meniscus), and return-to-sport planning. Patient writes their athletic injury details and uploads reports.

services.title: Others Consultation
services.description: Specialist consultation for general body aches, post-surgical rehabilitation (TKR, THR, Spine surgeries, Fractures), chronic pain syndromes, or custom movement rehabilitation. Patient writes their custom concerns and uploads reports.

testimonials.comment: After my ischemic stroke, I could hardly move my right arm. Dr. Sai Tejaswini’s dedicated Bobath techniques and constant encouragement brought back 90% of my arm movement in 3 months! Her online consultations were super convenient for weekly progress checks.

Being an IT manager working 10 hours a day, severe neck radiation pain was affecting my life. Dr. Tejaswini diagnosed cervical nerve impingement and guided me through ergonomic exercises and online video sessions. Painless now!

I booked online consultation video sessions with Dr. Tejaswini after my knee surgery. Highly professional guidance, genuine empathy, and systematic exercise demonstration over Google Meet. Best online physiotherapy service!

blogs.title: Understanding Neuroplasticity in Post-Stroke Recovery
blogs.excerpt: How the brain rewires itself after a stroke and why early physical therapy is critical within the golden window.
blogs.content:
Stroke is one of the leading causes of long-term disability. However, the human brain possesses a remarkable phenomenon called neuroplasticity — the ability of neural networks to reorganize, form new connections, and relearn lost motor functions.

Key Pillars of Neuroplasticity in Rehabilitation:
1. High Repetition & Targeted Exercises: Repeating functional movements stimulates cortical motor mapping.
2. Bobath & PNF Concepts: Guiding normal movement patterns prevents compensatory bad postures.
3. Task-Specific Training: Practicing real-life tasks like grasping a cup or standing up from a chair.
4. Consistent Online & In-clinic Guidance: Regular weekly evaluation ensures progressive overload.
blogs.author: Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini, MPT (Neuro), MIAP

blogs.title: 5 Desk Ergonomic Fixes to Prevent Tech-Neck & Lumbar Pain
blogs.excerpt: Simple daily posture adjustments and micro-stretches for software professionals and desk workers.
blogs.content:
With prolonged screen time, modern professionals frequently suffer from Cervical Spondylosis and Lumbar disc strains.

Top 5 Ergonomic Principles:
1. Eye-Level Display: Keep top 1/3rd of screen at direct eye level.
2. 90-Degree Rule: Elbows, hips, and knees positioned at 90 degrees with lumbar cushion support.
3. The 30-Minute Microbreak: Stand up and do 3 chin-tucks and standing back extensions every 30 minutes.
4. Avoid Text-Neck: Raising smartphone to eye level reduces neck load from 27kg down to 5kg!
blogs.author: Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini, MPT (Neuro), MIAP

faqs.question: How does an online consultation work?
faqs.answer: After you book, you receive a Google Meet link for your slot. On the call, Dr. Tejaswini takes your history, assesses your movement and posture on camera, goes through any scans you have shared, and gives you a home exercise programme.

faqs.question: What conditions fall under Neurological Rehabilitation?
faqs.answer: Dr. P. Sai Tejaswini specializes in Stroke (Hemiplegia), Parkinson’s disease, Spinal Cord Injury, Brain Trauma, Multiple Sclerosis, Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS), Facial Palsy, and Balance/Gait ataxia.

faqs.question: Can I share my MRI or X-ray reports before the consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Attach PDF or JPG reports while booking, or later from Track booking, so Dr. Tejaswini can read them before your session.
